title: Equipment & Vehicle Loans — Product Line Guide: Collateral, Loan Size, Term and Installment Frequency
content:
Equipment & Vehicle Loans are installment loans of Cottonwood Plains Farm Credit secured by the units they finance. The line is offered as six products, listed below in rank order, each with its own collateral, entry requirements and loan limits.

## The six products and their entry requirements

| Rank | Product | Collateral financed | Entry requirements | Largest loan (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Truck & Trailer Loan | titled farm truck, semi tractor or trailer | title lien notation required | 200000 |
| 2 | EquipDirect Dealer Contract | units sold by a participating dealer | originated by a participating dealer; dealer program agreement required; minimum credit score 680 | 500000 |
| 3 | Used Equipment Loan | pre-owned machinery | maximum unit age 12 years; independent valuation over 150000 USD | 750000 |
| 4 | New Equipment Loan | new machinery of the current or next model year | at least 2 years farming | 1500000 |
| 5 | Irrigation System Loan | center pivot, well, pump or drip system | fixture filing required; landowner consent if the land is leased | 1500000 |
| 6 | Grain Storage & Handling Loan | grain bins, dryers, legs and handling equipment | fixture filing required; engineered plan required | 3000000 |

## Loan size, advance and unit age limits

| Product | Smallest original principal (USD) | Largest original principal (USD) | Longest term (months) | Largest advance, new unit (% of purchase price) | Largest advance, pre-owned unit (% of purchase price or appraised value) | Oldest unit at funding (years from model year) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Truck & Trailer Loan | 10000 | 200000 | 60 | 85 | 80 | 10 |
| EquipDirect Dealer Contract | 15000 | 500000 | 60 | 90 | 80 | 12 |
| Used Equipment Loan | 15000 | 750000 | 60 | 0 | 75 | 12 |
| New Equipment Loan | 25000 | 1500000 | 84 | 85 | 0 | 0 |
| Irrigation System Loan | 50000 | 1500000 | 120 | 80 | 0 | 0 |
| Grain Storage & Handling Loan | 75000 | 3000000 | 144 | 75 | 0 | 0 |

## Installment frequency and first installment

| Product | Installment frequencies the member may choose at funding | Most calendar days from funding to the first installment due date |
|---|---|---|
| Truck & Trailer Loan | monthly | 45 |
| EquipDirect Dealer Contract | semiannual, annual | 365 |
| Used Equipment Loan | monthly, quarterly, semiannual, annual | 365 |
| New Equipment Loan | monthly, quarterly, semiannual, annual | 365 |
| Irrigation System Loan | semiannual, annual | 365 |
| Grain Storage & Handling Loan | semiannual, annual | 365 |

## Meaning of each figure

- **Smallest original principal** — the smallest original principal booked, in USD.
- **Largest original principal** — the largest original principal booked, in USD.
- **Longest term** — the longest term from funding to the final installment, in months.
- **Largest advance, new unit** — the largest loan as a percentage of the purchase price for a new unit; 0 means new units are not financed under that product.
- **Largest advance, pre-owned unit** — the largest loan as a percentage of the purchase price or appraised value for a pre-owned unit; 0 means pre-owned units are not financed.
- **Oldest unit at funding** — the oldest a financed unit may be at funding, in years from its model year; 0 means new units only.
- **Installment frequencies** — the installment frequencies the member may choose at funding.
- **First installment** — the most calendar days from funding to the first installment due date.

## Reading the tables

- A Used Equipment Loan shows 0 under the new-unit advance: that product does not finance new units. The New Equipment Loan, Irrigation System Loan and Grain Storage & Handling Loan show 0 under the pre-owned advance and 0 under unit age: they finance new units only.
- Hypothetical illustration: a pre-owned unit with model year 2015 is 11 years old in 2026. Under the Truck & Trailer Loan (oldest unit 10 years) it is beyond the limit; under the Used Equipment Loan or the EquipDirect Dealer Contract (oldest unit 12 years) it is within it.
- A Truck & Trailer Loan installment schedule is monthly only, and its first installment falls no more than 45 calendar days after funding; on every other product of the line the first installment may fall up to 365 calendar days after funding.
